import requests, numpy as np, json, collections

 'LEU':'L','LYS':'K','MET':'M','PHE':'F','PRO':'P','SER':'S','THR':'T','TRP':'W','TYR':'Y','VAL':'V'}
def parse(t):
    o=[]
    for l in t.splitlines():
        if l.startswith(('ATOM','HETATM')) and l[16] in (' ','A'):
            o.append(dict(rec=l[:6].strip(),name=l[12:16].strip(),res=l[17:20].strip(),ch=l[21],num=int(l[22:26]),
                xyz=np.array([float(l[30:38]),float(l[38:46]),float(l[46:54])]),b=float(l[60:66])))
    return o
A=parse(S.get('https://files.rcsb.org/download/9FVU.pdb',timeout=120).text)
D=parse(S.get('https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-Q5U4P2-F1-model_v6.pdb',timeout=120).text)
fe=[a for a in A if a['res']=='FE'][0]['xyz']; akg=np.array([a['xyz'] for a in A if a['res']=='AKG'])
def fasta(acc):
    return ''.join(S.get(f'https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta',timeout=60).text.split('\n')[1:])
ASPHD1=fasta('Q5U4P2'); ASPH=fasta('Q12797')

C 0 -3 -3 -3 9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
Q -1 1 0 0 -3 5 2 -2 0 -3 -2 1 0 -3 -1 0 -1 -2 -1 -2
E -1 0 0 2 -4 2 5 -2 0 -3 -3 1 -2 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
G 0 -2 0 -1 -3 -2 -2 6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2 0 -2 -2 -3 -3
H -2 0 1 -1 -3 0 0 -2 8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2 2 -3
I -1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3 4 2 -3 1 0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1 3
L -1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3 2 4 -2 2 0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1 1
K -1 2 0 -1 -3 1 1 -2 -1 -3 -2 5 -1 -3 -1 0 -1 -3 -2 -2
M -1 -1 -2 -3 -1 0 -2 -3 -2 1 2 -1 5 0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 1
F -2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1 0 0 -3 0 6 -4 -2 -2 1 3 -1
P -1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4 7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
S 1 -1 1 0 -1 0 0 0 -1 -2 -2 0 -1 -2 -1 4 1 -3 -2 -2
T 0 -1 0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1 1 5 -2 -2 0
W -3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1 1 -4 -3 -2 11 2 -3
Y -2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3 2 -1 -1 -2 -1 3 -3 -2 -2 2 7 -1
V 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 3 1 -2 1 -1 -2 -2 0 -3 -1 4"""
ln=b62.strip().split('\n'); cols=ln[0].split(); BL={}
for r in ln[1:]:
    p=r.split()
    for c,v in zip(cols,p[1:]): BL[(p[0],c)]=int(v)
def nw(a,b,go=-11,ge=-1):
    n,m=len(a),len(b); NEG=-1e9
    M=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Ix=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG);Iy=np.full((n+1,m+1),NEG)
    tM=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);tx=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8);ty=np.zeros((n+1,m+1),np.int8)
    M[0,0]=0
    for i in range(1,n+1): Ix[i,0]=go+ge*(i-1); tx[i,0]=1
    for j in range(1,m+1): Iy[0,j]=go+ge*(j-1); ty[0,j]=2
    for i in range(1,n+1):
        ai=a[i-1]
        for j in range(1,m+1):
            s=BL.get((ai,b[j-1]),-1)
            o=(M[i-1,j-1],Ix[i-1,j-1],Iy[i-1,j-1]);k=int(np.argmax(o));M[i,j]=o[k]+s;tM[i,j]=k
            o2=(M[i-1,j]+go,Ix[i-1,j]+ge);k2=int(np.argmax(o2));Ix[i,j]=o2[k2];tx[i,j]=k2
            o3=(M[i,j-1]+go,Iy[i,j-1]+ge);k3=int(np.argmax(o3));Iy[i,j]=o3[k3];ty[i,j]=k3
    i,j=n,m;st=int(np.argmax([M[n,m],Ix[n,m],Iy[n,m]]));P=[]
    while i>0 and j>0:
        if st==0: P.append((i,j));ns=tM[i,j];i-=1;j-=1;st=int(ns)
        elif st==1: ns=tx[i,j];i-=1;st=int(ns)
        else: ns=ty[i,j];j-=1;st=2*int(ns)
    return P[::-1]
pairs=nw(ASPHD1,ASPH); m_a2d={j:i for i,j in pairs}
caA={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in A if a['name']=='CA' and a['ch']=='A' and a['rec']=='ATOM'}
caD={a['num']:a['xyz'] for a in D if a['name']=='CA'}
def kabsch(P,Q):
    pc,qc=P.mean(0),Q.mean(0); H=(P-pc).T@(Q-qc); U,Ss,Vt=np.linalg.svd(H)
    d=np.sign(np.linalg.det(Vt.T@U.T)); R=Vt.T@np.diag([1,1,d])@U.T; return R,qc-R@pc
cur=[(i,j) for i,j in pairs if j in caA and i in caD and j>=560]
for cut in [6.0,4.0,3.0,2.5,2.5]:
    P=np.array([caD[i] for i,j in cur]);Q=np.array([caA[j] for i,j in cur])
    R,t=kabsch(P,Q);dev=np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1)
    cur=[c for c,dd in zip(cur,dev) if dd<cut]
P=np.array([caD[i] for i,j in cur]);Q=np.array([caA[j] for i,j in cur]);R,t=kabsch(P,Q)
rms=np.sqrt((np.linalg.norm((R@P.T).T+t-Q,axis=1)**2).mean())
print(f'Core superposition: {len(cur)} CA pairs, RMSD = {rms:.2f} A (ASPH oxygenase/DSBH region)')
for a in D: a['sx']=R@a['xyz']+t
plddt={a['num']:a['b'] for a in D if a['name']=='CA'}

TIP={'HIS':['ND1','NE2'],'ASP':['OD1','OD2'],'GLU':['OE1','OE2'],'CYS':['SG'],'SER':['OG'],'THR':['OG1'],
     'TYR':['OH'],'ASN':['OD1','ND2'],'GLN':['OE1','NE2'],'MET':['SD'],'ARG':['NH1','NH2','NE'],'LYS':['NZ'],'TRP':['NE1']}
print('\n========== 1. ASPH 9FVU metal site (direct from crystal structure) ==========')
for a in A:
    if a['res']=='FE': continue
    d=np.linalg.norm(a['xyz']-fe)
    if d<2.6: print(f"   Fe .. {a['ch']} {a['res']}{a['num']} {a['name']:<4} {d:5.2f} A")

print('\n========== 2. ASPHD1 atoms near the transferred Fe position ==========')
cand=[]
for a in D:
    d=np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-fe)
    if d<8.0 and a['name'] in TIP.get(a['res'],[]):
        cand.append((d,a['res'],a['num'],a['name']))
cand.sort()
print('  nearest metal-ligating-capable side-chain atoms (His/Asp/Glu/Cys first):')
for d,rn,num,nm in cand[:14]:
    flag=' <== classic Fe ligand type' if rn in ('HIS','ASP','GLU','CYS') else ''
    print(f"   {rn}{num:<4} {nm:<4} {d:5.2f} A   pLDDT={plddt.get(num,float('nan')):.0f}{flag}")
best_class=[c for c in cand if c[1] in ('HIS','ASP','GLU','CYS')]
print(f"\n  >>> closest His/Asp/Glu/Cys donor atom to Fe position: {best_class[0][1]}{best_class[0][2]} {best_class[0][3]} at {best_class[0][0]:.2f} A"
      f"  (Fe-N/O coordination requires ~2.0-2.3 A)")
allnear=sorted([(np.linalg.norm(a['sx']-fe),a['res'],a['num'],a['name']) for a in D])[:8]
print('  any ASPHD1 atom closest to Fe position:')
for d,rn,num,nm in allnear: print(f"   {rn}{num:<4} {nm:<4} {d:5.2f}")

print('\n========== 3. Residue-by-residue mapping of the ASPH active site ==========')
site=[(679,'Fe ligand'),(725,'Fe ligand'),(668,'2OG C1 carboxylate'),(735,'2OG C5 carboxylate'),
      (690,'2OG binding'),(688,'2OG binding'),(625,'2OG binding'),(719,'2OG pocket'),(670,'2OG pocket'),
      (737,'2OG pocket'),(727,'2OG pocket'),(711,'2OG pocket'),(739,'2OG pocket')]
rows=[]
for num,role in site:
    ar=[a for a in A if a['ch']=='A' and a['num']==num and a['rec']=='ATOM']
    aa_asph=AA3.get(ar[0]['res'],'X') if ar else '?'
    di=m_a2d.get(num)
    aa_d1=ASPHD1[di-1] if di else None
    # 3D distance between ASPH tip atom and ASPHD1 CB (superposed)
    tipA=[a for a in ar if a['name'] in TIP.get(ar[0]['res'],['CB'])]
    dd=np.nan; nearest_in_d1=''
    if di:
        dcb=[a for a in D if a['num']==di and a['name']=='CB']
        acb=[a for a in ar if a['name']=='CB']
        if dcb and acb: dd=np.linalg.norm(dcb[0]['sx']-acb[0]['xyz'])
    rows.append(dict(ASPH=f'{aa_asph}{num}',role=role,ASPHD1=(f'{aa_d1}{di}' if di else 'no equivalent'),
                     conserved=(aa_d1==aa_asph), CB_dist=round(float(dd),2) if dd==dd else None,
                     pLDDT=round(plddt.get(di,float('nan')),0) if di else None))
import pandas as pd
df=pd.DataFrame(rows); pd.set_option('display.width',200)
print(df.to_string(index=False))
print(f"\n  Conserved: {df.conserved.sum()}/{len(df)} active-site positions")

print('\n========== 4. 2OG / substrate pocket in ASPHD1 ==========')
clash=[]; 
for a in D:
    dmin=np.min(np.linalg.norm(akg-a['sx'],axis=1))
    if dmin<3.0: clash.append((round(float(dmin),2),a['res'],a['num'],a['name']))
print('  ASPHD1 heavy atoms within 3.0 A of the transferred 2OG (steric occlusion):', len(clash))
